methods.description: Pair a given expanded prime factorisation and multiply one prime from each pair.
Halve each even prime index to find a whole square root.
Construct a complete factor tree then pair prime leaves to find the square root.
Identify a positive perfect square by checking every prime index is even.
Find a square side from prime factors of its area/count, then required perimeter.
Add or remove exactly one copy of each unpaired prime to find a least positive multiplier/divisor.
Square the entire prime-factor root, doubling each prime count.
